model_annotation: This bar chart is designed to present the percentage change || (percentage change) over specific months, comparing two different years (2022 and 2023) to a forecasted year (2024). The horizontal axis enumerates the months from I to XII. The vertical axis quantifies the percentage change, ranging from 0.000% to 140.000% with consistent intervals of 20.000%. Each month is represented by three vertical bars—blue for the year 2022, orange for 2023, and grey for 2024—indicating the respective percentage changes for those periods. The bars are arranged in descending order of height within each month category, starting with the highest percentage change. The chart includes a legend in the upper right corner, matched to the colors of the bars, to help differentiate the years. The layout and colors facilitate a clear comparison of the percentage changes across the different months and years.
